boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Canisius traditions spanning the academic year, campus celebrations, scholarship, orientation, and the Niagara rivalry.

cards.title: Annual Bonfire
cards.subtitle: Start-of-year Griffin spirit event
cards.notes: Bring a purple item for the campus purple swap, then join the community as the annual bonfire opens the academic year.
cards.short_summary: A start-of-year bonfire paired with a purple apparel swap.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius identifies the Annual Bonfire as an annual tradition that kicks off the academic year and includes a purple swap.
cards.access_notes: Check GriffConnect or Student Engagement announcements for the current event details.

cards.title: Fall Fest
cards.subtitle: Seasonal campus celebration
cards.notes: Watch campus announcements for Fall Fest and use it as a low-key way to mark the change of season with other Griffs.
cards.short_summary: A Canisius fall gathering featuring seasonal activities and kettle corn.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius describes Fall Fest as an annual tradition combining last-chance summer activities with fall traditions.
cards.access_notes: Dates and activity details vary; consult current university event listings.

cards.title: Thanksgiving Sit Down
cards.subtitle: Faculty-and-staff-served community meal
cards.notes: Look for the annual Thanksgiving Sit Down and share the traditional meal, where faculty and staff serve the campus community.
cards.short_summary: A Thanksgiving meal served to students by faculty and staff.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius states that its annual Thanksgiving Sit Down brings the community together for a traditional meal served by faculty and staff.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the year's date, location, and meal access through university event communications.

cards.title: Griffmas
cards.subtitle: End-of-fall-semester tree lighting
cards.notes: Close the fall semester at Griffmas by attending the annual tree lighting and the accompanying games and activities.
cards.short_summary: A semester-closing tree-lighting celebration with games and Petey Claus.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius describes Griffmas as an annual fall-semester close featuring a tree lighting, games, activities, and Petey Claus.
cards.access_notes: Check current campus event listings for timing and location.

cards.title: Winter Carnival
cards.subtitle: Spring-semester kickoff in the dining hall
cards.notes: Start the spring term at Winter Carnival, when the dining hall is set up for carnival games and fair-style food.
cards.short_summary: A dining-hall carnival that opens the spring semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius says Winter Carnival kicks off the spring semester by turning the dining hall into a carnival with games and fair food.
cards.access_notes: Event timing and dining-hall arrangements are announced by the university.

cards.title: 100-Day Party
cards.subtitle: Countdown to graduation
cards.notes: If you are in the graduating class, watch for the 100-Day Party and celebrate the milestone of 100 days until graduation.
cards.short_summary: A class-year countdown marking 100 days to graduation.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius lists the 100-Day Party among its traditions and frames it as a celebration of 100 days remaining until graduation.
cards.access_notes: Designed around the graduation countdown; confirm participation details with Student Engagement.

cards.title: Griffest
cards.subtitle: End-of-year parking-lot carnival
cards.notes: When the end of the academic year approaches, look for Griffest’s carnival setup near Lyons Hall and join the campus celebration.
cards.short_summary: Canisius’ end-of-year carnival, held by Lyons Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius calls Griffest its end-of-year celebration and says the parking lot by Lyons Hall becomes a giant carnival.
cards.access_notes: Verify the annual date, location details, and any ride or activity requirements before attending.

cards.title: Ignatian Scholarship Day
cards.subtitle: Annual student research showcase
cards.notes: Set aside time each spring to view student presentations and research displays, or share your own work through the annual showcase.
cards.short_summary: An annual spring showcase of Canisius student research.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius identifies Ignatian Scholarship Day as an annual spring-semester showcase for student research and achievements.
cards.access_notes: Consult current academic and campus event announcements for presentation and visitor details.

cards.title: New Griff Orientation
cards.subtitle: Two-day welcome for incoming Griffs
cards.notes: Incoming students can use the two-day New Griff Orientation program to meet peers and begin navigating their Canisius experience.
cards.short_summary: A two-day orientation tradition for incoming Canisius students.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius describes New Griff Orientation as a two-day program of multiple activities that starts students’ college experience.
cards.access_notes: For incoming students; use current orientation communications for registration and schedule details.

cards.title: Canisius v. Niagara Basketball
cards.subtitle: Golden Griffs–Purple Eagles rivalry game
cards.notes: Follow the basketball schedule and plan ahead for the Canisius–Niagara matchup, a recurring campus rivalry moment for Golden Griffs.
cards.short_summary: The annual-style basketball rivalry between Canisius and Niagara.
cards.evidence_claim: Canisius presents its basketball game against Niagara’s Purple Eagles as a legendary athletic rivalry and campus tradition.
cards.access_notes: Tickets may be required; verify the current athletics schedule and ticketing information.
